source: PC Night of the Hunter: the dog whistle is an inventory item from the hall's chest of drawers, used from the kitchen while the neighbour is at the record player (Steam guide 2584421942; Badinfos' run, lap 2). The mobile has no whistle — its Dog is a Zone06 Alerter. PC anger (game.exe, docs/PC_ROUTINES.md "The anger and the bonus"): PCAngryTime on the Rottweiler is level_hunter/level.xml's angrytime=240 (1/12 s ticks: the level state ticks 12 times a second, as the HUD clock shows) — the rage current a trick without its own value is set to and the mercury's full scale; PCAngryTime on an item is its tricks.xml angrytime (ElectricTrap 272, GroundMarbles 360); the profile holds the current 60 ticks, counts it down one per tick and pays +3 for a trick fired while it is above zero (pcprofile.s1_rage_*).

InventoryItems.DescriptionString: Only the dog hears it. The neighbour hears the dog.
